items.headline: Security firm discloses serious flaw in Claude Code desktop app
points: Noma Security disclosed security flaws in the Claude Code desktop app. One has a CVSS severity score of 8.7.
CSO Online says a 256KB blind spot let developers' secrets show up in the preview pane.
None of today's reports says whether Anthropic has fixed the flaws.
